_meta.analysis_axes: functional isomorphism (same job) != structural isomorphism (dynamics/thresholds/inhibition match) != fractal integrity (recursive rule survives the scale jump). Judged separately, never conflated.

verdict_codes.STRUCTURAL: same part, same job, dynamics match; fractal intact.
verdict_codes.PARTIAL: real correlate, dynamics partly match; fractal bends.
verdict_codes.COSMETIC: sounds alike, dynamics differ; FLAGGED - breaks the fractal.
verdict_codes.MISSING: load-bearing neural part with no reliable business correlate; build target / pathology risk.

structural_anchors.neural: Cortical laminar hierarchy (layers I-VI, up/down streams): feedforward = prediction error ascending, feedback = predictions descending (Shipp 2016).
structural_anchors.business: The Atlas 9-tier authority ladder (Owners -> Board -> CEO -> C-Suite -> BU Presidents -> VPs/Directors -> Managers -> Professionals -> Operational).
structural_anchors.invariant: Fractal intact ONLY IF the ladder carries signal in BOTH directions AND laterally. A pure top-down tree is the cosmetic (broken) version (see chart_B org-tree).

structural_anchors.neural: The brain's three inhibition sources: top-down cortical/executive control (vertical) + intrinsic inhibitory interneurons & homeostatic plasticity (internal) + lateral inhibition between competing units (lateral).
structural_anchors.business: The Atlas 3-layer regulation model: State regulation from above (vertical) / Self-regulation from within (internal) / Market-mutual regulation from the side (lateral).
structural_anchors.invariant: Three independent brakes, same geometry (vertical / internal / lateral). All three must be present; losing one is a disinhibition pathology (see chart_D).
structural_anchors.atlas_ref: universal.regulationLayers (Layer 1 State / Layer 2 Self / Layer 3 Market)

unified_rule.neural: Predictive coding: only the mismatch (prediction error) propagates upward; matches are summarized away.
unified_rule.business: Management-by-exception / exception reporting: escalate variance, summarize the expected.
unified_rule.enforce: Route surprise-only upward across ALL scales. Routing full status reports upward instead violates the rule and produces executive overload (see chart_D sensory-gating-failure).
unified_rule.cross_link: Related motif M6 in motif-apqc-crosswalk.json (feedforward prediction + error).

chart_B_cosmetic_guard._purpose: Fractal-breakers. Each LOOKS like a match but the dynamics diverge. Used by neuro-business-guard.js to FLAG a proposed mapping as COSMETIC.

items.why_cosmetic: IT is wiring + glia (white-matter tracts, infrastructure, buffering), NOT the computational nervous system. Cognition is the distributed decision fabric across all tiers. Localizing cognition in IT = calling the corpus callosum 'the brain'.
items.correct_reading: IT = axonal tracts + astrocytic support; cognition is distributed, not departmental.

items.why_cosmetic: A brain is ~80% recurrent/lateral, densely feedback-connected. A pure org TREE has no lateral or feedback edges. Same picture, opposite connectivity.
items.correct_reading: Structural ONLY IF lateral + feedback channels exist; otherwise cosmetic and pathological (see chart_C dense-recurrent-connectivity).

items.why_cosmetic: Mapping 'dopamine = sales, serotonin = HR' is cosmetic. The real invariant is the ROLE TRIAD: excitatory / inhibitory / modulatory, not the named chemical.
Neural health is HOMEOSTASIS, not maximal firing. Maximal firing = seizure. Growth without matched inhibition is the PATHOLOGY, not the health.
The brain has NO CEO neuron. Control is distributed (basal ganglia select, cortex predicts, thalamus gates, brainstem arouses). A single-point controller is LESS brain-like.
items.correct_reading: CEO ~= a neuromodulatory + basal-ganglia FUNCTION, not a homunculus.

items.why_cosmetic: Money is fungible, storable, conserved; neural signals are transient, typed, non-conserved. Partial at best.
items.correct_reading: Closest correlate is dopamine/reward currency, but the analogy is loose.

doctrine_call.problem: Project doctrine forbids scale-dependent special cases ('no scale-specific rules'). C2 items appear to need one.

time_ratio_target.neural: Fast-signal (AP ~1 ms) vs slow-governance (hormonal feedback ~seconds-minutes) spans ~10^3-10^5.
time_ratio_target.business_target: An operational decision (minutes-hours) vs a governance/strategy cycle (weeks-quarters) must span a comparable ~10^3-10^4.
time_ratio_target.violation: If governance reacts as fast as operations (or operations wait as long as governance), the two-timescale invariant breaks and the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
time_ratio_target.cross_link: Generalizes the ratio_preservation_rule already in energy-neuro-substrate.json (Part XV) to the business-side span.
